section.placeholder: This section comes in later tasks.

login.title: Staff sign-in
login.enrollText: The admin panel is protected by a second factor. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (for example, Google Authenticator) and enter the code it shows. If the app already has a FLAGMAN Drive entry from an earlier attempt, delete it: its codes no longer work.
login.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
login.secret: If you cannot scan it, enter this key in the app:

errors.missingCredentials: Enter your work email and password.
errors.emailFormat: Check your work email: it is written in Latin letters, for example name@flagman.by.
errors.codeOutcomeUnknown: Could not find out whether the code was accepted: the connection broke. Reload the page: if the sign-in went through, it will be restored.
errors.totpInvalid: Wrong code. Check the time on your phone and enter a new code.
errors.challengeExpired: The time to enter the code is over. Sign in again.
errors.enrollmentNotStarted: 2FA setup has not started. Sign in again to get the QR code.
errors.alreadyEnrolled: 2FA is already set up for this account. Sign in again and enter the code from the app.
errors.resetRequired: 2FA sign-in is locked. Ask an administrator to reset your 2FA.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.rateLimitedFor: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.profileFailed: You are signed in, but the profile did not load. Reload the page.
errors.network: The server is unreachable. Check the connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Could not sign in. Try again.

login.logoutFailed: Could not end the session on the server: reloading the page may sign you back in. Please sign out again.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.text: This section is not available for your role.

audit.staffUnavailable: Could not load the staff list: ids are shown instead of emails.
audit.filterByStaff: Show only the actions of staff member {{name}}
audit.moreFailed: Could not load more events. Please try again.
audit.invertedRange: "From" is later than "To": swap the dates.
audit.rejected: The server did not accept this log request. Change or reset the filters.

queue.shown: Showing the first {{shown}}; the rest appear as these are decided.
queue.approved: Application approved: the client may now rent.
queue.rejected: Application rejected: the client will see the reason and can submit again.

profile.title: Profile data
profile.hint: Check it against the documents in the photos.

kyc.decided: This application has already been decided.
kyc.notSubmitted: The client has not submitted the application yet.

documents.title: Documents
documents.rateLimited: Too many photo views. Try again later.

approve.title: Approve
approve.licenseIssuedOn: License issue date (from the license photo)
approve.hint: The server checks the age and the driving experience against this date and the date of birth.

reject.title: Reject
reject.hint: Say what to fix, for example: "The selfie is blurry, take it in good light".

errors.reasonTooLong: The reason is longer than {{max}} characters.
errors.licenseDateInvalid: The license issue date cannot be in the future or before the date of birth.
errors.requirementsNotMet: The client is too young or has too little driving experience. Reject the application with a reason.
errors.profileIncomplete: The client's profile has no name or date of birth. Reject the application and ask them to fill in the profile.
errors.notPending: Another staff member has already decided this application.
errors.invalid: The server did not accept the decision: check what you entered.
errors.forbidden: Decisions on applications are not available for your role.
errors.failed: Could not save the decision. Please try again.
